clips.title: The story
paras: At the Crossroads, Sergra Darkthorn sends young Horde warriors after the zhevra. Their hunt tests the skills needed to face the Barrens' more dangerous beasts.

After the plainstriders, Sergra Darkthorn sends you after tougher prey. Zhevras run in herds across the northern and southern Barrens. They are not the savanna's fiercest beasts, but they are swift and stubborn, and their kicks can break bone.

Sergra uses the hunt to test your growing skill. She asks for four intact hooves as proof of the kill and warns that a zhevra's rear kick can knock a grown tauren onto their haunches. Passing this trial brings you closer to facing the plains' predatory prowlers.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: The zhevra, although not the fiercest beast in the Barrens, are a shade tougher than the plainstriders. Don't worry -- we'll send you against bigger prey in good time, but for now your teeth could use a little more cutting.
Hunt the zhevra to the north and south, and collect their hooves. Bring them to me and perhaps we'll next send you against something tougher.

clips.title: Progress
paras: How many zhevra have you slain?

clips.title: Completion
paras: Not bad, friend. Those zhevra hold a lot of strength in their legs. A sharp kick from them can knock even a tauren on its haunches!
It looks like you have some strength in you too. Are you ready for a real challenge?

sources.title: Quest text as quoted on the Warcraft Wiki
